overall: The AG resolved the complaint by informal action and found no violation: the Council recessed rather than convened in executive session, so no stated purpose was required.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Council convened in executive session at its July 22 meeting without stating the purpose for the session.
allegations.key_passage: Because the Council did not convene in executive session during this meeting, it was not required to announce the reason for its recess, and therefore did not violate the Open Meeting Law.
